first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE Index Polygons Source Metadata XML is a distinct public/no-login metadata window, but the data.gov.uk metadata endpoint redirects to a harvest-object XML endpoint that is not accessible through the current transport. No concrete INSPIRE polygon feature, INSPIRE ID, canonical_parcel_id, or canonical parcel bbox can therefore be asserted. Local OpenCode must retrieve/bind the concrete parcel geometry; after that bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the bbox.
exact_blocker: The official data.gov.uk catalogue exposes a Source Metadata XML resource for HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons, but the current transport cannot follow the redirect to the CKAN harvest-object XML endpoint. This is a materially different metadata-access method from the prior GML download, transaction-to-INSPIRE CSV lookup, and WMS GetCapabilities attempts, yet it still cannot yield a concrete parcel feature or identifier here. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
